title: Social network for seniors
summary: A simple social app designed specifically for older adults.
whyTempting: Ageing populations, loneliness among seniors, and they have money.
whyItFails: Seniors don't want a 'seniors app'. Segmenting by age feels patronising. They're already on Facebook. Where their families are. Distribution is hard. Seniors are expensive to reach and onboard.
whatWouldChange: Selling through aged-care providers or families rather than direct to seniors.

attempts.notes: Social network for people over 40 from Monster.com's founder; sold in 2011, closed in 2012.
